cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

mechanism: A presents a rehearsal booking as already approved while granting calendar preferences and paperwork help to make B use a confirmed status without checking the approval source.
confusable: Unlike ordinary negotiation over availability, A insists authorization is complete; confidence depends on B accepting a procedural shortcut and entering it.
comparison: Calendar hold/confirmed status differs from physical storeroom inspection access.
seedUse: Use D66-b own stamp/approval processor/held-versus-confirmed and S02-a claiming a modified procedure as settled.
